newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Orrefors owners delay equity statement.
newsitem.headline: Orrefors owners delay equity statement.

text.p: The main owners of Swedish glassmaker Orrefors Kosta Boda said on Tuesday that talks on the future of the company were taking longer than expected and a statement on the company's future ownership would be delayed until later in the day.
A joint statement on Friday said Swedish investment groups Investor AB and Proventus AB and Danish porcelain and silver group Royal Copenhagen AS, were in discussions over Orrefors' future ownership.

Trading in Orrefors Kosta Boda was immediately suspended, with last trade at 140 crowns ($21.31) , pending an announcement which the companies said would be made before the Stockholm bourse opened at 0900 GMT Tuesday.

Investor spokesman Nils Ingvar Lundin told Reuters the talks were talking longer than expected and the statement was delayed. He said it would be released later on Tuesday but was not specific on a time.
Investor, the investment arm of Sweden's Wallenberg business empire, is currently the largest shareholder in Orrefors Kosta Boda with a 23.1 percent stake.
Royal Copenhagen has a 17.1 percent holding and unlisted Proventus 21.1 percent with an option to tkae a further 9.1 percent stake.
